location.climate: Four seasons, cold winters (-5°C to 0°C), warm summers (20-28°C)

required_documents.notes: Official, with course descriptions for non-US schools
Educational Counselor interview if available in your area

academic_programs.curriculum_structure: GIRs (General Institute Requirements) including 6 science core courses + HASS (Humanities, Arts, Social Sciences) + Major requirements

korean_student_organizations: MIT Korean Scientists and Engineers Association (KSEA)
korean_student_specific.korean_food_access: H Mart in Cambridge (15 min by T), multiple Korean restaurants in Allston (20 min), Korean bakeries nearby
korean_student_specific.korean_church_proximity: Boston Hankook Church (20 min), Cambridge Korean Church (15 min)

historical_admit_patterns.common_profiles: Strong STEM olympiad background (KMO, KPhO, KBO), genuine research experience with publications, unique hands-on projects, demonstrated 'maker' mentality

korean_specific_advice: MIT values 'making things' - demonstrate building/creating physical or software projects
Research experience highly valued but must show genuine intellectual contribution, not just lab work
Essays should show quirky personality and passion, not just achievements
KMO/KPhO participation viewed positively but not required - what you do with knowledge matters more
Strong English communication skills essential for interview
Show collaboration - MIT culture is intensely collaborative, not competitive
Demonstrate persistence through failure - 'mens et manus' (mind and hand)
common_korean_applicant_mistakes: Over-focusing on olympiad credentials without showing personality or 'Why MIT'
Essays too formal/achievement-focused, lacking genuine voice and quirks
Not demonstrating 'match' with MIT's hands-on, building-focused culture
Generic description of activities without showing deep passion
Failing to show what problems they want to solve, not just skills they have
Not highlighting collaborative experiences - only individual achievements

campus_life.dining_options: Multiple dining halls, diverse international cuisine, halal and kosher options
campus_life.safety_rating: High - Campus Police, escort services, well-lit campus
campus_life.nearby_attractions: Boston, Harvard Square, Charles River, Museums, Fenway Park

career_outcomes.korean_alumni_network: Strong MIT Korean Alumni Association with active mentorship programs
